entities.name: Manuel García-Prieto, 1st Marquis of Alhucemas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel García Prieto, 1st Marquis of Alhucemas was a Spanish politician who served as prime minister several times in his life and as the 30th Solicitor General of Spain. He was a member of the Liberal Party. During his last term, he was deposed by Miguel Primo de Rivera.
